title: modernish teapot and cup set
text: modernish teapot and cup set. Tea set comes with teapot, lid, 6 cups and 6 saucers.  There is a stand that is a separate purchase and does a good job organizing all the pieces. I did wash on the top rack of dishwasher, which has a delicate cycle - they did great.  There is no maker mark on any piece - they are completely clear of any markings on the bottoms..  It feels like a nice china/ceramic.  All pieces are white.  The lid has a little catch (which I appreciate) so when you are pouring, the lid stays in place.  The set is smaller in size... the cups hold about 6 oz  eyeballing them.  The saucers are slightly egg shaped with a little lift on one edge - style? The lift edge does help pick up the saucer.  I appreciate handles on cups when what being served is hot. To me, the overall effect of the set is modern, or fantasy like.  I haven't used it yet, but it is a lovely set.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
